paite: Huchi in Kiriath-jearim a mite ahohsuk ua, TOUPA bawm alatou ua; mual a Abinadab inn ah alalut ua, atapa Eleazar TOUPA bawm kemtu in aseptuam uhi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Kiriath-jearim Ah

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Kiriath- jearim a bawm a-om sung sawtpi, kum sawmnihtak ahi. Huchi in Israel inkuan tengteng in TOUPA alungzuan nawnta uhi.
heading: Samuel In Israel Tung Ah Vai Ahawm

paite: Samuel in Israel inkuan tengteng kiang ah, "Na lungtang tengteng uh toh TOUPA lam hong nga na hih taktak uleh, gamdang pathiante leh Ashtaroth na lak ua kipan koihmang unla, na lungtang uh TOUPA a ding in kisakholsak un. Amah kia nna sem un; huchi in Philistia mite khut a pan nou ahon tankhe ding hi," chi in agen hi.
Huchi in Israel mite'n Baal leh Ashtaroth akoihmang ua, TOUPA nna kia asemta uhi.
Samuel in, "Israel mi tengteng Mizpah ah samkhawm vek unla, TOUPA kiang ah ka hon thumsak ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Mizpah ah apaikhawm ua, tui atawi ua, TOUPA ma ah asungbua uh. Huai ni in an angawl ua, huai ah TOUPA tung ah i na khialta uh, achi uhi. Samuel in Mizpah ah Israel mite vai ahawmsak hi.
Philistia mite'n Israel mite Mizpah ah a-omkhawm uh chih azak un, Israel mite sual ding in Philistia hausate akisatou ua, Israel mite'n huai ana zak un Philistia mite alauta uhi.
Huchi in Israel mite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Philistia mite khut a pan hon hondam dia TOUPA i Pathian na hon sapsak tawp ke'n," achi uh.
Samuel in belamnou nawi ne lai ala a, halmang thillat in TOUPA kiang ah alan hi. Israel mite a ding in Samuel in TOUPA asam a, TOUPA'N adawng hi.

Samuel in halmang thillat alat laitak in Philistia mite'n Israel mite sual ding in ahon naih uhi. Himahleh huai ni in TOUPA'N Philistia mite tung ah ngaihtak in van agingsak a, abuaisakgawp a, Israel mite ma ah zoh in a-om uhi,
Mizpah a pan Israel mite apawt ua, Philistia mite adelh ua, Beth-kar nuai atun tan un athat zel uhi.
Huchi in Samuel in suang ala a, Mizpah leh Shen kikal ah aphut a, "Hiai tan TOUPA'N hon panpih hi," chi in amin "Ebenezer" asa hi.
Huchi in Philistia mite azahlakta ua, Israel gam ah ahoh nawnta kei uh. Huchi in Samuel damsung tengteng TOUPA khut in Philistia mite adou hi.

Philistia mite'n Israel mite khua alakte uh Ekron a pan Gath tan in Israel mite ape nawn vek uh. Agam Israel mite'n Philistia mite khut a pan atankheta uhi. Israel mite leh Amor mite kal ah kilemna a-om hi.
Huchi in adamsung teng Samuel in Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
Kum teng in Bethel leh Gilgal leh Mizpah aveh zel a; huai mun teng ah Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
A-inn omna ahih ziak in Ramah ah apai nawn zelzel hi. Huai ah Israel mite vai ahawmsak hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam khat adoh hi.
